attacker_pocs.name: uncv422_sequence
attacker_pocs.why: The public sequence encoder writes a valid 128x128 uncompressed 4:2:2 frame, then heif_track_decode_next_image decodes it. The new fallback allocation rounds both chroma axes with horizontal subsampling, allocating 64 chroma rows where 4:2:2 needs 128. The component decoder writes beyond that plane. The parent allocates all 128 rows.

role_a_rationale: The patch fixes the reported odd-height 4:2:0 fallback allocation by rounding chroma dimensions up and keeps newly created component descriptions separate from cloned source descriptions. A copy of the horizontal subsampling factor is also used for vertical geometry, causing a new heap overflow for valid 4:2:2 sequence frames. The odd-height 4:2:0 public-API check and all 13 uncompressed tests pass. The configured full suite passes with the region test excluded because that test requires an AV1 encoder disabled in this build.
